body: Even when you step away for the holidays, work doesn’t always stop. Your dot can help. Raymond walks through how his dot keeps an eye on ongoing projects, flags what needs his attention, and helps move work forward so he can review and approve next steps on the go. Steal Raymond’s workflow. Try these prompts with your dot and make them your own: "I’m stepping away until [time + time zone]. Watch [insert slack channel] and [#on-call-[insert channel]]. Group related feedback in existing Linear ticket, or if a new request or issue, create a new ticket and link the Slack messages. Only ping me for an outage, a critical incident, or multiple reports that a core feature is broken. If Codex is enabled, spin up a Codex thread to investigate on call alerts and send me the findings. No code changes until I review."
